# Cambridge Dictionary

> > Comprehensive English dictionary and language learning resource from Cambridge University Press, featuring definitions, pronunciations, thesaurus, translations across 19 languages, and corpus-based usage examples.

Cambridge Dictionary provides authoritative English language reference materials drawn from the Cambridge English Corpus, Cambridge Learner Corpus, and other scholarly sources. The platform serves language learners from A1 to advanced levels with British and American English variants, specialized dictionaries (Business, Academic), collocations, and multilingual translation support including Bengali, Vietnamese, and other languages.

## Key Topics

- Cambridge English Corpus
- Cambridge University Press
- English language learning
- Dictionary definitions
- Word meanings and pronunciations
- British and American English

- Collocations and word combinations

- Grammar reference

- A1-C2 proficiency levels
- English vocabulary
- Language accessibility

## Core Dictionary Resources

- [Cambridge Dictionary | English Dictionary, Translations & Thesaurus](https://dictionary.cambridge.org): Homepage for Cambridge Dictionary with access to all language resources
- [Cambridge English Dictionary: Meanings & Definitions](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english): Main English dictionary with British/American pronunciations & definitions
- [Cambridge Free English Dictionary and Thesaurus](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary): Dictionary selector page for English & translation dictionaries
- [Cambridge Thesaurus | Synonyms, antonyms and examples](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/thesaurus): Thesaurus with synonyms, antonyms & usage examples in British/American
- [Cambridge Essential American English Dictionary](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/essential-american-english): Learner's dictionary for beginners with essential American English words

## Translation & Multilingual Tools

- [TRANSLATE in English, Spanish, French and more with Cambridge](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/translate): Free translator supporting 19 languages with dictionary integration
- [GUIDE | ইংরেজি থেকে বাংলা অনুবাদ করুন - Cambridge Dictionary](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/bn/dictionary/english-bengali/guide): English-Bengali translation entry for 'guide' with examples
- [ABOUT | ইংরেজি অর্থ - Cambridge Dictionary](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/bn/dictionary/english/about): Bengali translation entry for preposition 'about'
- [FAQ | Phát âm trong tiếng Anh](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/vi/pronunciation/english/faq): Vietnamese interface page for 'FAQ' pronunciation with IPA symbols

## Collocations & Word Combinations

- [guide বিন্যাস | দ্বারা বাক্য বিন্যাস Cambridge Dictionary](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/bn/collocation/english/guide): Collocations for 'guide' with Bengali interface & corpus examples
